recommendation: Keep the source fix. It preserves the FHIR-13610 operation behavior and aligns the active operation with the later resource rename; do not publish a duplicate FHIR-16936 decision because that issue already has a combined-branch audit commit.
issue_request: FHIR-13610 was Published with a Persuasive resolution to create a $submit operation for EligibilityRequest that accepts a single request resource or a Bundle of request resources without requiring a Parameters wrapper.
initial_application: Tracker #13610 was historically applied by ab55d1f02c558ddf2f35ff5be98f2a105324f382, which added the submit operation rows to the EligibilityRequest spreadsheet, and a53ff5fbd9dfe5cffcc57785901bde6e26469780, which added the missing $submit request and response example files.
additional_context: FHIR-16936 later renamed EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse and is already represented on the combined branch by 6ccf62e5d425508416491ed9b50b308b0fe0d266. The active current build includes coverageeligibilityrequest=CoverageEligibilityRequest and lists OperationDefinition/CoverageEligibilityRequest-submit, but the active submit operation definition and request example still used old EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse wording in operation-specific implementer-facing text.
reconciliation: Updated source/coverageeligibilityrequest/operationdefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest-submit.xml to use CoverageEligibilityRequest and CoverageEligibilityResponse in the title, description, and in/out parameter documentation, and updated source/coverageeligibilityrequest/$submit-request.txt to POST [baseurl]/CoverageEligibilityRequest/$submit.
source_changes: source/coverageeligibilityrequest/operationdefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest-submit.xml: changed the operation title, description, input documentation, and output documentation from EligibilityRequest/EligibilityResponse to CoverageEligibilityRequest/CoverageEligibilityResponse.
source/coverageeligibilityrequest/$submit-request.txt: changed the sample endpoint from POST [baseurl]/EligibilityRequest/$submit to POST [baseurl]/CoverageEligibilityRequest/$submit.
